svg.title: Native-time R-MSRM matrix product: shared latent, modality filter, participant map
svg.text: A temporal filter acts on rows; a feature map acts on columns
Observed Y = Ŷ + residual; only unmasked, response-eligible entries contribute.
R-MSRM: centered/scaled Y. GP-MSRM: continuous latent operator, plus fitted feature offsets.
